items.title: General Quantification of Covariate and Concept Shifts
items.abstract: Generalization under distribution shift remains a core challenge in modern machine learning, yet existing learning bound theory is limited to narrow, idealized settings and is non-estimable from samples. items.title: Data Scarcity and Model Sparsity: Mixtures-of-Experts Overfit More to Repeated Data
